newsitem.title: USA: Unitog sees Q3 EPS below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Unitog sees Q3 EPS below estimates.

text.p: Unitog Co said Tuesday it expects earnings for the third quarter ended October 27 to be below analysts' current estimates, but to exceed last year's $3.3 million or $0.35 a share.
According to First Call, the range of estimates for the third quarter is $0.42 to $0.44 a share, with a consensus of $0.43.
Unitog, which provides uniform rental services, said it expects third quarter revenues to be up about 25 percent from a year ago.
Unitog also said it expects its fourth quarter earnings will exceed the $0.32 a share it made a year earlier, but likely will be below current analysts' estimates.
J. Craig Peterson, senior vice president of financial and administration, said First Call estimates for the fourth quarter are around $0.44 a share.
Unitog said the projected shortfall in earnings is due to its recent Central Quality Service Corp acquisition.
"The assimilation of this acquisition is taking longer and is more costly than originally anticipated," Randolph Rolf, chairman, said in a statement.
Peterson told Reuters that Unitog is still pleased with the acquisition.
